kpis.description_fr: Encours cartes crédit private label + co-brand. Reprise post-COVID, normalisation 2024-25. Partnership PayPal, Amazon, Lowe's, Sam's Club.
kpis.description_en: Private label + co-brand credit card receivables. Post-COVID recovery, 2024-25 normalization. PayPal, Amazon, Lowe's, Sam's Club partnerships.

kpis.description_fr: Volume achats cartes (purchase volume). Sensible spending consommateur lower-income, ralentissement 2024-25.
kpis.description_en: Card purchase volume. Sensitive to lower-income consumer spending, 2024-25 slowdown.

kpis.description_fr: Taux pertes nettes annualisé. Pic 2024 post-normalisation, amélioration progressive 2025. Élevé vs grands émetteurs (subprime mix).
kpis.description_en: Annualized net charge-off rate. 2024 peak post-normalization, gradual improvement 2025. High vs large issuers (subprime mix).

kpis.description_fr: NIM Synchrony. Très élevé (card APRs 25-30%). Bénéficie repricing CFPB late-fee rule en cours, hausse APRs 2024.
kpis.description_en: Synchrony NIM. Very high (card APRs 25-30%). Benefits from CFPB late-fee repricing in progress, 2024 APR hikes.

kpis.description_fr: Comptes actifs (au moins une transaction sur 12 mois). Tightening credit standards 2024-25 limite croissance.
kpis.description_en: Active accounts (at least one txn in 12mo). 2024-25 credit tightening limits growth.

kpis.description_fr: Provisions / créances. Très élevé reflet portefeuille subprime/near-prime. Pic CECL stabilisé.
kpis.description_en: Allowance to receivables. Very high reflecting subprime/near-prime book. CECL peak stabilized.
